title: DragonSpeed BR1 - Gulf Livery (2018–2019)
subtitle: Dallara
description_it:
The DragonSpeed BR1 was a prototype racing car developed by BR Engineering in collaboration with Dallara, built to compete in the top-tier LMP1 category of the FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC). During the 2018–2019 Super Season, DragonSpeed fielded the BR1 with a distinctive and nostalgic Gulf Oil livery, featuring the iconic light blue and orange color scheme — a tribute to endurance racing history.
Powered by a naturally aspirated Gibson V8 engine, the BR1 was designed for high downforce, low drag, and long-distance durability…
